So basically Miranda’s child Eveline died during the Spanish flu, in her grief she went into a cave to die and came into contact with the megamycete, and she used the people in the village nearby to make experiments with the megamycete—which is what we call the mold. To see which villager survived the parasite, how strong they got etc. the strongest of these were Lady Demitrescu, Moreau, The doll and Heisenburg. She created a whole fake religion about herself to keep the villagers there. Miranda was a kind of medical student i believe which is how she was able to do these experiments. In her research is where she met spencer. Miranda wanted to bring back one person, while spencer went off to found umbrella using the mold along with everything else that happens in games 1-6. They knew each other and founded it, which was why Umbrella popped up here and there. 

Ethan died back in Louisiana trying to rescue Mia, and if you remember, all the family members were dead people brought back by the mold/Eveline who was a mold child. A child Mia was working to investigate by pretending to be family. In the shipwreck of the game is where Eveline escaped and attacked the family, turning them all into mold for her sick sense of what family was. Ethan died in re7 but came back as Mold, Mia knew but never told him, and since he was revived with the mold from Eveline, when he procreated with Mia it created this superhuman baby. Rose. 

Miranda found out about this, i imagine because she was keeping tabs on everything her mold was touching. And replaced Mia to try to take Rose and use her in a ceremony using her other Cadou/Megamycete “children” of the village to bring back her original child Eveline, which obviously didnt work. And boom. Re8

This game is more fantasy, but Miranda is a character that ties into the original RE franchise and the Cadou is another form of all the viruses we’ve survived since you can infect people with it to either make them powerful or turn them into Lycans. Lycans were failed experiments (the villagers) Rose now carries this legacy with her and she’s back into the fold where every other character is since Chris helped raise her.

(RE4 Lord Saddler)

Want to “change the world/the next step in evolution” (RE5Wesker)
(RE1 Spencer)

Or just straight up nothing other than just Corporate Greed (RE2 Umbrella)

The scary themes of Resident Evil have always been Horror Survival and Body Horror. 

But there has always been the overlooked Main theme of The Loss of Humanity and its effects.

Because of Umbrella, Spencer, Saddler, Wesker, and Miranda, countless lives have been destroyed and lost. All because of their delusions of grandeur, their selfishness, and their utter disregard for human life causes these games. But the ones who end them are our Protagonists. The ones who are brave enough, who still have their sense of integrity, and above all have the ones who still have their humanity to stop the outbreaks. 

Evil may run rampant but in doing so it creates the Heroes that will be their own undoing. 

I understand the feeling of an antagonist that doesn’t have a goal that can be understood, but if you look closer to the themes in these games that are presented, you can still appreciate RE.

In a way it’s good we can say we don’t understand the enemy goal/it doesn’t make sense. GOOD. You cant expect someone to understand Insanity. There’s no rational and logic to justify any of it, because in the end, they only care about what they want and how to achieve. Even if it means millions must die. 

So in conclusion with the theme of loss of humanity and complete insanity being our lens for the world of RE makes a bit of sense. These games are not only entertaining but teaches us the monsters that look like you and me can devastate the world, but also there are Heroes who can and will stop them. 

The shorter version: Resident Evil theme as a  game has been survival horror but the moral theme has been,

 how many horrors and dead bodies can a selfish and callous person create when they have the power of biological pathogens to use for their own insane goals?

(Spoilers) So firstly you HAVE to understand that Ethan is actually infected by the Mold. It seems to behave differently in different people but it could also depend on the amount of Mold that's infected the person in question.

In the real world, reattaching severed limbs and/or digits is possible many a surgeon is capable of this. But it's not nearly as fast or as pretty as games make it seem.

So it's still a horror game. And still very much a fantasy setting. But not like what you think.
